Every clip starts 0.24-0.28 s before its first word. No cold opens in this episode: 11 of 12 openers are already a punchy line, and the only workable lift (w07) failed the 2026-10-06 loudness/energy rule. edit_notes.reason: Drops 7 s of her getting up and leaving the chair; from his laughing family shot to the wide of her reaching reception, both shot changes.

clips.notes: Flashback, dental clinic, 7:29-8:19. Visual: the opening words are plain ('Hello', 'Hello సోహం', 'ఎక్కడున్నావ్'); the hook is what we see: the first frame is Soham answering her call with the girl in his arms (7:29), and frames 7:32-7:45 show Soham in a checked shirt holding the girl beside a woman in white while he lies on the phone, and she watches. No cold open: the only lifts were his lie (a 5.2 s shot, meaningless without the picture) or the receptionist's line (the payoff). At reception she shows his photo on her phone (8:06-8:08). Ends on her shocked reaction, 4.2 s after the line, on the shot change at 8:19.5. Not marked spoiler: this is why she broke up (the flashback's answer). The episode later hints it was not what it looked like (mother: 'సోహంకి అలా జరిగిందని', then 'Soham చనిపోయాడురా!'), so the clip plays the misdirect the episode itself sets up. Founder may disagree. clips.why_it_works: Having heard half of Hamsini's story, Aravind decides the ex was a fraud and plans to win her. Keerthi, called to hospital: 'I'll tell you the rest later'. He shrugs it off.

standalone_risks.note: 'ఎన్ని నాటకాలు ఆడాడు' opens on 'he' (Soham) before the clip explains he hurt Hamsini.

clips.notes: CEMNT café, 9:09-10:01, continuous. Dramatic irony: 'bro balance జరిగిందంతా నేను మళ్ళీ వచ్చి చెప్తా' is the episode's hook (the rest is that Soham died), and Aravind waves it off. No spoiler. Weak opener for a new viewer. A cold open with the receptionist's 'సోహం సర్ వాళ్ళ wife and వాళ్ళ పాప' (8:13.2-8:15.5, ends on a cut) would explain 'he' at once. It comes from the previous scene, not from inside the clip, so I did not do it. Ends on his smug wide shot before the night cityscape at 10:01. Keerthi is speaker_0 here (normally Hamsini's id). ASR: 'face గురించి' = 'phase గురించి', 'నమ్కకూడదని' = 'నమ్మకూడదని', 'next time ఎట్లే ఇస్తానో' is unclear (maybe 'entry ఇస్తానో').

clips.text: నువ్వు ఆపుతావా ఆపవా? నీకు సోహం గురించి ఏం తెలుసు అని మాట్లాడుతున్నావ్ రా. ఆ ఆ అంటే కీర్తి చెప్పింది. వాడు నిన్ను మోసం చేశాడని. అందుకే నీ life లోకి ఎవరినీ రానివ్వట్లేదని. మిమ్మల్ని ప్రేమించి మిమ్మల్ని మోసం చేసిన వాళ్ళనంటేనే మీరు తట్టుకోలేకపోతున్నారే! మరి నేను ఇంతలా ప్రేమించిన మిమ్మల్ని ఎవడైనా ఇబ్బంది పెడితే నేను ఎలా తీసుకోవాలి? నాకు కోపం రాకూడదా? But అసలు correct కాదండి. But క- Soham చనిపోయాడురా! నన్ను వదిలేయ్ please.

hook_line.text: నువ్వు ఆపుతావా ఆపవా? నీకు సోహం గురించి ఏం తెలుసు అని మాట్లాడుతున్నావ్ రా.

clips.title: నాకు కోపం రాకూడదా?… 'సోహం చనిపోయాడురా!'
clips.why_it_works: Aravind insists Soham cheated her and he has a right to be angry for the woman he loves. Hamsini grabs his shirt and breaks: 'Soham is dead!' SPOILER: the episode's twist.
clips.notes: SPOILER: reveals the episode's main twist (24:33.7). Included for the founder to decide, ranked last on purpose. w01 is the spoiler-free cut of the same scene, and the two overlap only in her 'నువ్వు ఆపుతావా ఆపవా? నీకు సోహం గురించి ఏం తెలుసు'. Visual: frames 24:32-24:34 she pulls his shirt, his shocked close-up 24:35-24:39, she wipes tears and says 'నన్ను వదిలేయ్ please' (24:46). Ends on his face, on the shot change at 24:49.9, before she walks off and the garlanded photo of Soham (25:20). Music swells from 24:35; the clip stops inside it on a cut. ASR wrote 'Soham' in Latin script.
